'''Lord of Chaos signing tour, Santa Monica 28 October 1994 - report by Justin Howell'''



I received a few tidbits of wisdom from the Creator at the signing.<br />Specifically:<br />



Where did Artur Hawkwing start out? (IIRC, John Novak suggested this question in a post after the Chicago signing).<br />

Answer: None, but he said that one could figure it out given a careful reading of the books. Sounds like Tear to me (as Mr. Novak predicted).<br />



When I asked about the hemisphere of the Seanchan continent, RJ said that it had parts in both the northern and southern hemispheres, but that Rand and Aviendha Travelled to a part in the southern hemisphere.<br />



Tiny spoilers follow.<br />

This should be enough space.<br />



RJ said that there is no connection whatsoever between the Gholam (Aginor's monster), and the Gho'hlem (a tribe of Trollocs).<br />



He also refused to state Beldeine's ajah, saying something to the effect of "Wait and find out. It's not really very important, anyway."<br />



That's all for my report.<br />

Justin Howell
